entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-TO-ATTACH
entities.description: A substate of EMM-DEREGISTERED entered by the UE when the attach or combined attach procedure fails due to missing network response or specific failure conditions.

entities.name: Attach procedure
entities.description: Initial registration procedure where UE attempts to attach to the network.

entities.name: Combined attach procedure
entities.description: Procedure combining EPS attach with non-EPS services attachment.

entities.name: Missing network response
entities.description: Condition where the UE does not receive expected response from the network during attach procedure.

entities.name: Specific attach failure conditions
entities.description: Failure conditions described in clauses 5.5.1.2.5, 5.5.1.2.6, 5.5.1.3.5 and 5.5.2.3.4 that trigger entry to ATTEMPTING-TO-ATTACH state.

relations.description: Missing network response during attach procedure causes UE to enter ATTEMPTING-TO-ATTACH state.
Specific attach failure conditions cause UE to enter ATTEMPTING-TO-ATTACH state.
Attach procedure can be guarded by condition of missing network response.
Combined attach procedure can be guarded by condition of missing network response.
